rows: Fast recovery, not always full backup

blocks.title: Backups, Replication, and Power Resilience exam shortcuts
items: Need protection from building loss → OFFSITE BACKUP
A same-site copy may be lost in the same disaster.
Example: Cloud backup survives a data-center fire.
Snapshots preserve a recent system state.
Example: Roll a VM back after a failed update.
Example: A secondary database stays synchronized.
Journals record changes so recovery can replay them.
Example: Database logs restore activity after the last backup.
Power fails for a few minutes → UPS
Example: Systems stay online long enough for a generator to start.
A generator provides sustained backup power.
Example: A data center continues during an extended utility outage.
blocks.example: Focus on recovery speed, continuity, redundancy, data loss tolerance, and site or power requirements.

questions.q: A company wants a backup copy that will survive destruction of the primary building. Which location is best?
questions.explanation: Offsite backups are geographically separate from the primary site.

questions.q: A company creates backups every hour instead of once per day to reduce potential data loss. Which backup consideration changed?
questions.explanation: Backup frequency determines how often recovery points are created.

questions.q: A VM must be quickly returned to the exact state it had before a failed update. Which option best fits?
questions.explanation: A snapshot captures a point-in-time system state for fast rollback.

questions.q: A secondary database is kept nearly synchronized with the primary database. Which technique is this?
questions.explanation: Replication keeps a copy updated on another system or site.

questions.q: A database records each transaction so changes can be replayed after restoring a backup. Which technique is this?
questions.explanation: Journaling records transactions or changes for granular recovery.

questions.q: Utility power fails and systems need immediate battery power until a generator starts. Which device should provide that bridge?
questions.explanation: A UPS provides immediate short-term power.

questions.q: A data center must continue operating during an extended utility outage. Which power source is most appropriate?
